verdict.rationale: PagerDuty clearly versions its APIs: there is a dedicated REST API versioning page with a version header that pins responses regardless of token [pagerduty-docs-48], plus an explicitly numbered Events API v2 [pagerduty-docs-31] and V3 webhooks positioned against previous versions [pagerduty-docs-33]. A community report notes that v1 and v2 Events API keys are incompatible and indistinguishable [pagerduty-comm-6], which is a usability caveat for multi-version coexistence. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, version lifecycle or changelog guarantees, and independent corroboration of smooth version migration.
